defectFoundAndCorrected.description: The Governance workflow listened only for pull_request default types (opened, synchronize, reopened). Editing a PR description therefore did NOT re-trigger the PR governance metadata check, and 'Re-run all checks' replays the ORIGINAL event payload — meaning a PR opened with an empty description could never pass that check no matter how many times it was re-run or corrected.
defectFoundAndCorrected.impact: Would have made the governance metadata gate permanently unsatisfiable for any PR opened before its description was filled in. The predictable workaround — disabling or ignoring the check — would have removed the enforcement entirely.
defectFoundAndCorrected.correction: Added types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened] to the pull_request trigger. Verified: check went green on the corrected description.
defectFoundAndCorrected.foundBy: Owner execution — the check failed with 'declared risk class: MISSING' against a description that was demonstrably populated.

ownerFindings.finding: Browser drag-and-drop upload silently skips dot-prefixed paths. The entire .github directory (7 files: CODEOWNERS, PR template, 2 issue templates, 2 workflows) plus .gitignore were dropped without warning.
ownerFindings.significance: Had this gone unnoticed, the repository would have appeared complete while enforcing nothing. Detected because the owner checked the uploaded file list against expectation rather than assuming success.
ownerFindings.correction: Files created individually via the browser's create-file path, which supports dot directories.

ownerFindings.finding: Assistant instruction would have produced a doubled path (.github/.github/pull_request_template.md) because GitHub retains directory context after a commit.
ownerFindings.significance: Caught before commit by the owner. Instruction corrected to check the breadcrumb before typing a path.

ownerFindings.finding: Required status checks default to source 'Any source', which permits ANY entity with repository access to post a check with a matching name and satisfy the requirement.
ownerFindings.significance: HIGHEST-CONSEQUENCE FINDING. A required check satisfiable by an arbitrary reporter is not a control. Would have left a forgeable green tick on every governance gate.
ownerFindings.correction: Source pinned to GitHub Actions, so only the repository's own workflows can report check results.

thirdPartyAccess.issue: Had write access and overwrote the PR description — the field carrying governance evidence (risk class, evidence-honesty attestation, recovery procedure, approval record).
thirdPartyAccess.disposition: Suspended rather than uninstalled; reversible by the owner only. Excluded from required status checks.
thirdPartyAccess.residualRisk: Suspension is a setting, not structural removal. Recorded as accepted by John.
thirdPartyAccess.followUp: Confirm no Sourcery check appears on the next PR.

solooOwnerLimitation.constraint: GitHub does not permit a PR author to approve their own pull request. With one human, requiring 1 approval would deadlock every merge.
solooOwnerLimitation.handling: Required approvals set to 0. Automated checks are ENFORCED; human review is ATTESTED in the PR body.
solooOwnerLimitation.honestStatement: On this repository, human-review independence is attested, not enforced. Deterministic-check independence IS enforced. This is consistent with D-PAF-04, which made deterministic checks the independence backbone.
solooOwnerLimitation.changeTrigger: When a second human joins, set required approvals to 1 and enable dismissal of stale approvals. Human review then moves from attested to enforced.
